purpose: Behavioral parity catalog for extracting Spore recovery semantics without inheriting qualification.

behaviors.name: healthy-physical-boot-may-promote-exact-booted-generation
behaviors.selector: healthy renderer relinquishes DRM path and stable boot advances LKG
must_hold: graphical.target remains reachable
current semantic root resolves to /run/booted-system
last-known-good resolves to the exact physically booted generation after qualification
promotion receipt binds booted_generation and resulting_lkg_target

behaviors.name: stale-semantic-root-scratch-is-reconciled
behaviors.selector: stale semantic-root scratch is reconciled before state preparation
must_hold: stale temporary semantic-root links are removed before state preparation completes

behaviors.name: renderer-failure-is-fail-open
behaviors.selector: renderer process failure remains fail-open and does not poison system health
must_hold: renderer failure cannot prevent graphical.target
presentation failure alone does not poison independently qualified machine health

behaviors.name: renderer-timeout-is-bounded
behaviors.selector: stubborn renderer is forcibly bounded before desktop
must_hold: stubborn renderer is terminated or otherwise bounded
desktop availability does not depend on renderer completion

behaviors.name: failed-state-preparation-cannot-promote
behaviors.selector: failed preparation scrubs partial receipt, skips renderer, and never advances LKG
must_hold: partial state receipts are scrubbed
renderer is skipped when authoritative preparation fails
last-known-good is not advanced
decision receipt reports state-preparation-failed

behaviors.name: custom-runtime-paths-do-not-create-hidden-authority
behaviors.selector: custom state/runtime paths do not create hidden default directories
must_hold: configured runtime/state paths are honored
default runtime/state paths are not silently created

behaviors.name: state-blessing-failure-preserves-recovery
behaviors.selector: state blessing failure leaves old LKG untouched
must_hold: qualification/blessing failure does not create or advance LKG
temporary promotion state is not stranded
decision receipt records failed state-bless result

behaviors.name: health-window-requires-stable-display
behaviors.selector: display manager must remain stable across health window
must_hold: graphical availability remains independent of promotion
unstable display does not become LKG
qualification deadline terminates without converting unknown health into success

behaviors.name: live-activation-never-blesses-unbooted-candidate
behaviors.selector: live activation can never bless an unbooted candidate
must_hold: /run/current-system differing from /run/booted-system cannot advance LKG
existing LKG remains unchanged
decision receipt reports live-activation
non-authoritative evidence write failure cannot mutate LKG

behaviors.name: hung-prepare-helper-cannot-hold-boot
behaviors.selector: hung state preparation is bounded and cannot hold graphical boot
must_hold: graphical.target and display-manager remain reachable
hung preparation is bounded by timeout
no LKG promotion occurs

behaviors.name: hung-qualification-helper-is-terminal
behaviors.selector: hung LKG qualification is bounded and terminal
must_hold: hung qualification is bounded
promotion timer becomes terminal rather than retrying forever
last-known-good is not advanced
decision receipt reports state-qualification-timeout

behaviors.name: hung-lifecycle-evidence-cannot-block-power-transitions
behaviors.selector: hung lifecycle evidence cannot hold reboot service or sleep hook indefinitely
must_hold: reboot marker helper is bounded
sleep hook is bounded
real shutdown remains possible

behaviors.name: privileged-helper-is-confined
behaviors.selector: privileged state helper is confined to declared writable Spore paths
must_hold: sandbox-denied writes outside declared Spore paths do not succeed
failed helper cannot produce qualifying receipt
failed helper cannot advance LKG

behaviors.name: firmware-exhausts-bad-generation-and-recovers-known-good
must_hold: generation A physically boots and qualifies
generation B physically boots but never becomes LKG when graphical health is unstable
bootloader attempt budget for B is exhausted
after abrupt loss firmware returns to A
receipt records attempted B and restored A as rollback
three physical boots carry distinct kernel boot IDs

behaviors.name: systemd-hard-authority-from-spore-is-forbidden
must_hold: critical graphical/runtime units cannot Require, Requisite, or BindsTo Spore presentation services directly or transitively

behaviors.name: systemd-temporal-authority-from-spore-is-forbidden
must_hold: activation plus ordering cannot make a critical graphical/runtime path wait on Spore

behaviors.name: systemd-stop-and-conflict-authority-from-spore-is-forbidden
must_hold: Spore cannot own stop propagation of critical runtime units
Spore cannot conflict with critical runtime units
normal shutdown conflicts remain allowed

behaviors.name: systemd-authority-proof-fails-closed-on-incomplete-snapshot
must_hold: missing referenced units invalidate the proof input
malformed unit snapshots cannot yield a green authority proof
